caption: Search for a word: every match shows the heading path and the parent list items above it, merged into one tree for each note.
eval: (async()=>{ app.workspace.rightSplit.collapse(); app.plugins.plugins['context-trees'].pro.signOut(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); app.workspace.getLeavesOfType('context-trees').forEach(l=>l.detach()); const leaf=app.workspace.getLeaf('split','vertical'); await leaf.setViewState({type:'context-trees',active:true,state:{mode:'search',query:"pricing",regex:false}}); await app.plugins.plugins['context-trees'].firstView().runNow(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500));  return 'ok'; })()

caption: Fold a note or any branch with its arrow. Click a line to open the note at that line.
eval: (async()=>{ app.plugins.plugins['context-trees'].pro.signOut(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); app.workspace.getLeavesOfType('context-trees').forEach(l=>l.detach()); const leaf=app.workspace.getLeaf('split','vertical'); await leaf.setViewState({type:'context-trees',active:true,state:{mode:'search',query:"pricing",regex:false}}); await app.plugins.plugins['context-trees'].firstView().runNow(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); [...document.querySelectorAll('.ct-file')].slice(2).forEach(f=>f.classList.add('is-collapsed')); document.querySelectorAll('.ct-file')[0].querySelector('.ct-node .ct-node.ct-item')?.classList.add('is-collapsed'); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Pro: a regular expression, with the query saved as a chip for the next time.
eval: (async()=>{ const pro=app.plugins.plugins['context-trees'].pro; pro.opts.http=async()=>({status:200,json:{data:{viewer:{login:'demo-reader'},user:{sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor:{isActive:true,isOneTimePayment:false,tier:{name:'$5 a month',monthlyPriceInCents:500}}}}}}); app.secretStorage.setSecret('context-trees-github-token','gho_'+'0'.repeat(36)); await pro.refreshNow(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); app.workspace.getLeavesOfType('context-trees').forEach(l=>l.detach()); const leaf=app.workspace.getLeaf('split','vertical'); await leaf.setViewState({type:'context-trees',active:true,state:{mode:'search',query:"pric(e|es|ing)\\b",regex:true}}); await app.plugins.plugins['context-trees'].firstView().runNow(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); document.querySelector('.ct-switch[aria-label="Save this query"]').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); return 'ok'; })()
after: (async()=>{ const p=app.plugins.plugins['context-trees']; p.settings.saved=[]; await p.saveSettings(); p.pro.signOut(); app.workspace.getLeavesOfType('context-trees').forEach(l=>l.detach()); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Pro: the results as a new Markdown note, with the context trees as nested lists.
eval: (async()=>{ const pro=app.plugins.plugins['context-trees'].pro; pro.opts.http=async()=>({status:200,json:{data:{viewer:{login:'demo-reader'},user:{sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor:{isActive:true,isOneTimePayment:false,tier:{name:'$5 a month',monthlyPriceInCents:500}}}}}}); app.secretStorage.setSecret('context-trees-github-token','gho_'+'0'.repeat(36)); await pro.refreshNow(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); app.workspace.getLeavesOfType('context-trees').forEach(l=>l.detach()); const leaf=app.workspace.getLeaf('split','vertical'); await leaf.setViewState({type:'context-trees',active:true,state:{mode:'search',query:"pricing",regex:false}}); await app.plugins.plugins['context-trees'].firstView().runNow(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); await app.plugins.plugins['context-trees'].firstView().exportResults(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,900)); document.querySelectorAll('.notice-container .notice').forEach(n=>n.remove()); return 'ok'; })()
after: (async()=>{ const p=app.plugins.plugins['context-trees']; p.pro.signOut(); app.workspace.getLeavesOfType('context-trees').forEach(l=>l.detach()); for (const f of app.vault.getMarkdownFiles().filter(x=>x.basename.startsWith('Context trees pricing'))) { app.workspace.getLeavesOfType('markdown').filter(l=>l.view.file?.path===f.path).forEach(l=>l.detach()); await app.vault.delete(f); } return 'ok'; })()
